title: A first delivery orients on what the session holds before listing what it could take
outcome: A session receiving its first delivery is given a large ready list ahead of the little it needs to orient itself. Present what the session holds or is assigned first, bound the number of ready candidates, give each candidate the reason it is ready, and name the command that reaches the remainder, so the omitted part is reachable rather than lost.
acceptance: a first delivery to a session holding nothing presents held and assigned before ready candidates, bounds the candidate list, states for each candidate why it is ready, and names the continuation that reaches the rest; a test asserts the bound and that the omitted remainder is reachable through that named continuation
